jobs.title: IT Support and Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------



At Service Electric Company, we believe that each employee contributes directly to the success and growth of our company. Specializing in transmission, distribution, substation, storm restoration, and technical services., our rapid expansion follows our growing reputation for delivering safe, quality, and on\-time projects to all our customers. Whether we’re staffing internal support or in\-field workforce, we are guided by our Core Values of Quality, Safety, and Responsibility.
  

  

Incorporated in 1945, SERVICE ELECTRIC Company now employs over 2,000 employees and operates a fleet of more than 2,000 pieces of equipment. Our primary footprint includes the Southeast, Midwest, and Puerto Rico, but our crews travel throughout the Country to assist with storm restoration. Service Electric Company is a subsidiary of Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR).
  

  

Our culture is about supporting an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed.
**About this Role**
-------------------



The **IT Support \& Training Specialist**provides day\-to\-day technical support across our core systems and devices, while also serving as a hands\-on trainer, helping employees build confidence with their technology, from everyday devices to the AI tools we're rolling out across the company.
**What You'll Do**
------------------



**POSITION FUNCTIONS**
* Respond to, and triage, incoming IT support requests, resolving issues directly or escalating to the right team member.
* Manage the user account lifecycle in Active Directory — provisioning, changes, and deprovisioning for new hires, transfers, and terminations.
* Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, SharePoint, and shared/network drive permissions.
* Provision, configure, and troubleshoot company mobile devices; coordinate with wireless carriers and vendors on service requests.
* Provide hardware and software troubleshooting support for laptops and desktops.
* Coordinate with HR and field offices on new\-hire IT setup and employee status changes.
* Support basic network connectivity troubleshooting, escalating more complex issues to network engineering.
* Help manage access and provisioning for enterprise AI tools as adoption grows.
* Partner with the IT Manager to identify recurring support issues and recommend process or training improvements.
* Lead hands\-on device training for new hires and existing employees (laptops, mobile devices, core business systems).
* Deliver basic AI literacy training — teaching employees how to use company\-approved AI tools safely and effectively.
* Create and maintain simple how\-to guides and quick\-reference materials (e.g., in SharePoint).
* Travel periodically to other company locations to run in\-person training sessions.
* Other duties as assigned.
**What You'll Bring**
---------------------



**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**
* A high school diploma or equivalent.
* 1 to 3 years experience in an IT support or helpdesk role.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft 365 (Outlook, SharePoint).
* Experience troubleshooting Windows desktop/laptop hardware and software issues.
* Experience supporting mobile devices (iOS) in a business environment.
  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
* Comfortable presenting to and training groups of employees, in person and virtually.
* Capable of handling multiple projects concurrently with good time management.
* Detail\-oriented, with strong ticket and task\-tracking habits.
* Strong ability to identify and solve issues.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical staff.
* Strong customer service skills and willingness to learn/teach.
* Self\-motivated.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to conducts self in an appropriate manner as a representative of SEC, working effectively in a diverse work environment.
  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (A PLUS, BUT NOT REQUIRED)**
* Experience with construction or field\-services ERP systems (e.g., Viewpoint Spectrum).
* Familiarity with SSO/identity protocols (SAML, OIDC).
* Experience with mobile forms platforms (e.g., GoCanvas, MS Forms, Origami).
* Exposure to VoIP/UCaaS phone systems (e.g., Teams Phones).
* Familiarity with AI chatbot tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and general AI literacy.
* Experience developing training content or leading onboarding sessions.
* Basic understanding of networking/SD\-WAN troubleshooting.
**What You'll Get**
-------------------



**WORKING ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENT:** This position will work in\-person in an office setting.  

*NOTE: This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, working conditions, physical demands, and activities may change or new ones many be assigned at any time with or without notice.*  

*Service Electric Company provides Equal Employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*  

*This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------



All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
  

  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
  

  

We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed.


Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.


We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager / Senior Implementation Manager to join our Success Services team in the US. You will lead Front’s most complex customer implementations across net\-new onboarding, enterprise expansion, workflow transformation, migration, and adoption of new capabilities.


You will be the customer’s primary implementation partner and a senior advisor throughout the engagement. You’ll uncover business goals, translate complex processes into scalable Front workflows, establish the project operating model, lead change and enablement, navigate technical dependencies, and drive teams toward measurable value.


This is a hands\-on role for an experienced implementation leader. You will independently manage high\-stakes engagements while also improving how our team works through stronger playbooks, reusable solutions, coaching, and cross\-functional partnership.

**What will you be doing?**

* Own complex, multi\-workstream implementation engagements from discovery and solution design through launch, adoption, and value realization.
* Advise customer leaders on future\-state workflows, operating models, governance, and change—not simply configure stated requirements.
* Build and drive clear project plans, decision frameworks, stakeholder cadences, risk registers, and executive updates across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Lead discovery workshops that uncover business goals, process gaps, technical constraints, change risks, and measurable success criteria.
* Guide solution design involving permissions, integrations, data flows, automations, migrations, APIs, webhooks, and Front’s AI\-powered capabilities; independently handle common technical topics and engage specialists intentionally.
* Lead change management, enablement, cutover, and adoption strategies for teams moving from deeply embedded legacy tools and processes.
* Navigate escalations with calm judgment, clear ownership, and an ability to align customers and internal teams around trade\-offs and a path forward.
* Partner with Sales, Solutions, Account Management, Product, Engineering, and Support to define scope, resolve blockers, and improve the customer journey.
* Turn recurring customer needs into reusable implementation assets, playbooks, templates, and delivery improvements.
* Support team development through mentoring, thoughtful feedback, knowledge sharing, and leadership on strategic initiatives.
* Represent the customer voice and implementation perspective in product and operational decisions.

**What skills \& experience do you need?**

* 5\+ years of experience leading customer\-facing SaaS implementations, professional services engagements, technical programs, or similarly complex transformation work.
* A track record of independently owning complex implementations from discovery through sustained adoption, including multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and technical dependencies.
* Strong consultative and systems\-thinking skills; able to diagnose underlying business problems and recommend a practical future state rather than order\-take.
* Excellent project leadership, including scope, timeline, governance, risk, executive communication, and management of multiple concurrent priorities.
* Demonstrated change\-management experience, including stakeholder mapping, resistance management, enablement, cutover, and reinforcement after launch.
* Strong technical fluency across integrations, permissions, data flows, automations, migrations, APIs, and webhooks; able to learn products quickly and know when deeper expertise is needed.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, facilitate difficult decisions, and build trust across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Sound judgment under pressure and experience recovering at\-risk projects or resolving escalations.
* Evidence of improving a services organization through reusable solutions, delivery methodology, enablement, mentoring, or operational improvements.
* Curiosity and practical judgment about AI and automation, including how to drive responsible customer adoption and improve personal effectiveness.

**What makes you a great fit?**

* You create clarity and momentum when the path is ambiguous.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and make recommendations grounded in customer outcomes.
* You connect business strategy, workflow design, technical constraints, and change management.
* You communicate credibly with executives while staying close to execution details.
* You anticipate risks early, make trade\-offs explicit, and recover quickly when plans change.
* You measure success by adoption and value—not activity or go\-live alone.
* You improve the system around you and help teammates raise their craft.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post\-series D \& backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
* Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
* Mental health support with Workplace Options
* Family planning support with Maven
* $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
* Wellness Days \- Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
* Winter Break \- Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

*Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *\&* *EU Privacy Notice*


Compensation Range: $155K \- $173K

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Remote position: must reside in the Orlando, Osceola, Polk , or Brevard markets\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: EverHealth: Director of Onboarding + Implementation
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 690,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/


We are looking for a **Director of Onboarding \& Implementation** at **EverHealth** to join our Customer Experience leadership team. EverHealth is simplifying the business of healthcare through simplified, user\-centric software which streamlines the daily operations of healthcare practices. Our EHR and billing solutions give small and medium\-sized practices an integrated ecosystem of intuitive, easy\-to\-use products that work with how providers run and grow their business.


**About the Role**


We're seeking an operational and visionary **Director of Onboarding \& Implementation** to lead the team that gets new EverHealth customers live on our EHR and billing products. This role owns the customer journey from signed contract through go\-live and early adoption for a high\-volume base of small and medium\-sized practices, delivered almost entirely without onsite implementation. You will be equally comfortable setting the long\-term vision for how onboarding should work at EverHealth and rolling up your sleeves to redesign a workflow, resolve an escalation, or coach a team member through a difficult go\-live.


Your north star is time to first value: how quickly and reliably a new practice experiences the outcomes they bought our software to achieve. You will also evolve the team's approach from software training to consultative practice partnership — helping customers rethink and improve how they run their business rather than simply teaching them which buttons to click — and make onboarding a continuation of the sales relationship rather than a handoff away from it. Reporting to the VP of Customer Experience, this role will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership to shape how EverHealth brings new customers into the fold.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Vision \& Strategy:** Define and evangelize a multi\-year vision for onboarding and implementation at EverHealth, translating it into a concrete roadmap across the EHR and billing product lines.
* **Time to First Value:** Own time\-to\-first\-value as the team's primary metric, redesigning milestones, workflows, and staffing models to shorten it without compromising quality.
* **Continuing the Sale:** Partner with Sales to treat onboarding as an extension of the buying journey — reinforcing the original value proposition and building momentum for retention and expansion from day one.
* **Consultative Transformation:** Shift the team's operating model from feature training to consultative, workflow\-based implementation, coaching specialists to diagnose a practice's operations and recommend how to run it on EverHealth, not just how to use it.
* **Cross\-Product Coordination:** Simplifying onboarding motions across multiple product/feature adoptions (payments, RCM, etc) to one coordinated implementation rather than two disconnected projects.
* **Remote\-First Delivery Model:** Build and continuously refine a scalable, primarily virtual delivery model suited to a high\-volume book of small and medium\-sized practices, reserving onsite engagement for the rare exception.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead a team of managers and help support ongoing development of the existing management team and frontline specialists, building career paths that reward consultative skill as much as technical proficiency.
* **Process \& Playbook Development:** Create repeatable playbooks, journey maps, and tooling, powered by AI, that let the team scale efficiently as customer volume grows, without sacrificing a tailored feel for each practice.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Sales to close feedback loops, resolve systemic issues, and ensure a seamless handoff at every stage of the customer lifecycle.
* **Performance Measurement:** Define, track, and report on key onboarding metrics (e.g., time to first value, time to go\-live, onboarding CSAT, adoption at 30/60/90 days) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* **Escalation Management:** Serve as an executive point of escalation for at\-risk implementations, working cross\-functionally to get stalled onboardings back on track.

**Skills \& Experience**


**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years leading Onboarding, Implementation, or Professional Services teams in SaaS, including at least 3\+ years in a director\-level or equivalent leadership role.
* Proven experience building or scaling a high\-volume, remote\-first onboarding model for small and medium\-sized customers, not a heavy onsite/enterprise implementation environment.
* Track record of shifting a team's approach from transactional training to consultative, outcomes\-based customer engagement, driven by AI and foundational digital\-led content to optimize the experience.
* Deep fluency in time\-to\-value, adoption, and onboarding health metrics, with the ability to translate data into operational change.
* Experience managing onboarding across multiple, distinct products or workflows simultaneously.
* Strong executive presence and cross\-functional influence, with the ability to partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable processes, playbooks, and tooling from the ground up.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with EHR, practice management, or medical billing/revenue cycle management software.
* Background in healthcare technology, digital health, or working with small and medium\-sized healthcare practices.
* Experience navigating HIPAA\-compliant environments or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with onboarding/CS tooling (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Smartsheet, or similar).
* MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus.

**Where:** \[this is a remote role, however, proximity to Denver, CO is a plus. Given the team's remote\-first delivery model, travel is minimal — occasional travel for company or team on\-sites]


The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in\-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


**Benefits and Perks** (JUST U.S.):


* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid
* Robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Student Loan Repayment Program

**Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $170,000 \- $190,000 USD per year with an incentive variable in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!
